cat > finish.py <<'PY'
import arena, subprocess,re,chess,sys
for i in range(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 10):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b);break
 out=subprocess.run(['./think',b.fen(),sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else '20'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
 lines=[x for x in out.splitlines() if ' pv ' in x and re.search(r' pv [a-h][1-8][a-h][1-8]',x)]
 if not lines: print(out);break
 line=lines[-1]; move=line.split(' pv ')[1].split()[0]
 print(line,flush=True)
 if chess.Move.from_uci(move) not in b.legal_moves: print('invalid');break
 b=arena._request('move '+move)
 print('Played',move,'reply',b.peek().uci(),'FEN',b.fen(),flush=True)
 if arena.result(b):arena.show(b);break
